inspected_source_refs.facts: Push main uses github.sha, full gate, SELF_RUN_ID, GH_TOKEN=github.token; 80-minute job timeout. No schedule/workflow_dispatch trigger. Permissions checks/statuses/contents read, actions write, pull-requests read.

Latest workflow selected by workflow identity and created_at/run_id/attempt; own workflow excluded, older runs superseded. Completed/attempt job inventory is authoritative. Advisory-only terminal workflow failures do not acquire synthetic gating failure when full inventory proves that classification.
Feature-matrix reporter is structurally required when real opt-in groups ran, and correlated via external_id to latest group run.
Explicit rate limit is a separate no-more-requests fail-closed path. Normal verdict requires every non-advisory check success/skipped/neutral with successful select.
Exact declared advisory names: review-lane blind-spot alarm; ring registry dispatcher; release-plz / Release-PR (advisory). clear the needs:area park is not declared advisory.
Completion recovery doorbell is restricted to failed same-repo pull_request aggregate events; push/merge_group is not eligible.
Scheduled path is zero-dispatch merge-group recovery; not a failed push-main aggregate recovery route.

scope: Read-only source inspection already completed; no policy execution or source changes. Exact commit/path citations are reproducible from Git; this freeze performs no additional source/API investigation.
